speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development for the past five years, what is the amount of grant and subsidies given to PAP Community Foundation for the set-up and operation of its childcare centres and kindergartens.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: In addition, AOPs offer Chinese, Malay and Tamil language instruction, and support enrolment of children from low-income families.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: The amount of Government grants provided to each AOP generally depends on the number of places and types of services provided by the AOP.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: As the size of AOPs varies substantially, it is more meaningful to look at the amount of grants provided to each Singapore Citizen (SC) child enrolled in each AOP.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: As the Member can see, the size of AOPs as well as the size of centres vary substantially.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: If the Member is aware and he goes on the ground, he would understand what I am trying to say, whereby behind the scenes. there are many differences.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: So, it is more meaningful for us to look at what I have shared earlier.
